surface_mechanism_description: Surface-functionalized atomic layer deposition (SF-ALD) enables stoichiometry tuning by modifying the amount of material deposited per cycle. Alcohols undergo a condensation reaction with surface hydroxyl groups to inhibit the deposition of the subsequent metal precursor. The subsequent oxidant pulse removes the remaining ligands from the metal as well as the SF-species. This process allows for the formation of surface species such as Bi-O-V-OH* and V-O-ROH* which are critical for the subsequent reactions.
